labels.variantDefinition: A timed or scroll-pinned run of full-screen frames, like film opening credits, revealing name, key facts and specimen, with a Skip intro control
labels.look: Black, viewport-filling white 'A' with '78 styles 13 weights +italics', 'Condensed Standard Wide' in the corners, progress line and 'Skip intro'
labels.ux: Plays frame by frame (neighbouring blocks add movie-credit lines in the counter); Skip intro and Buy buttons
labels.learn: Stage the key facts as an opening credit sequence, and always offer 'Skip intro' for returning visitors

labels.look: Saffron field, huge black headline 'Pro, Trial, Free: take your pick', three radio options with one-line licence summaries
labels.ux: Choose licence type, tick weights or bundles with live prices (£19 per weight, family discounts), enter email
labels.learn: Put trial and free personal use as equal options next to Pro, and state the licence length ('390 words') to lower the barrier

labels.variantDefinition: The family's size stated as one or two huge figures (glyph count, weights, styles), the numerals themselves acting as the specimen
labels.look: Off-white, giant '455' with one solid serif '5' over outlined digits, small centred '{ 8 variable weights } 455 glyphs'
labels.ux: Parallax caption and a paper-fold transition on scroll; Invert colours and Get the font in the header
labels.learn: Set the glyph count in the font's own numerals: the statistic and the specimen are one object

labels.variantDefinition: The family's logic (weight curve, optical sizes, widths) explained chapter by chapter with charts and technical diagrams, like a design-system manual
labels.look: Yellow and white chapters, huge 'system' and collaged 'STANDARD', weight-ladder 'A', numbered colour weights 1-7, line chart and stacked-disc diagram
labels.feel: Systematic, Swiss, engineering manual with colour
labels.ux: Long scroll with sticky axis headings, one optical-size toggle, sticky try/buy bar
labels.learn: Plot the weight axis as a real curve and give each weight a number and colour: the system becomes legible as data

labels.variantDefinition: A glyph grid where selecting a glyph shows it large beside the grid with metric lines (cap height, x-height, baseline) and outline or anchor views
labels.look: White, sticky large glyph left with dashed metric lines and numeric labels, thin-ruled grid of accented glyphs right
labels.ux: Click a glyph to inspect it; Solid/Anchors tabs switch the rendering; skip link to playground
labels.learn: Show metrics with real unit values (710, 530, 0, -150): it speaks the language of developers and type nerds at once

labels.look: Royal blue, 'WEIGHTS' marquee strip, each style name (DOT 1-3, STRIPE 1-3) set in itself in white; previous block's orange marquee at top
labels.learn: Name styles after their texture (Dot, Stripe) and set each name in itself: the list is the specimen

labels.look: Pink-to-violet gradient, white multi-line swash letters in centred rows, small 'Swashes' label, round down-arrow; one of a run of full-screen slides
labels.ux: Full-screen slide (pre-rendered image); down arrow jumps to the next slide
labels.learn: Give a special subset (swashes) its own full screen and colour, instead of burying it in the charset

labels.look: Cream with pale circles, rounded CJK characters in a 10-column grid, orange before/after pill toggle, mascot illustrations at edges
labels.ux: Toggle 調整前/調整後 (before/after adjustment) swaps the glyphs
labels.learn: Show the revision itself: a before/after toggle on the corrected characters makes invisible craft visible

labels.look: Split: cream panel of themed words (Warehouse, Evergiven, Freighting, Containers) alternating red and black, bold 'Extended Efforts' heading and prose right
labels.ux: Word stack animates from standard to extended width (wdth) through weights, with a slider gauge; sticky Typetester/Purchase bar
labels.learn: Introduce a subfamily by morphing themed words (shipping vocabulary) from the base width into it, next to the why
